name: Attendance
description: Owns activity-scoped participation, invitations and responses, expected rosters, presence observations, verified findings, corrections and authorised disclosure; not reservations, enrolment or specialist outcomes.

provides.description: Register and resolve scoped participants and roster identities.
Manage invitations, responses and non-binding participation intent.
Qualify source entitlement and effective eligibility without creating admission.
Record check-in, check-out and presence observations with provenance.
Verify, correct and dispute versioned findings.
Supply authorised participant, observation and aggregate views with coverage.
Accept qualified external observations and reconcile uncertain evidence.
Publish committed participant, response, observation, verification and correction changes.
